description: Version 1.0.1 harmonized baseline datasets for model-agnostic MSP-1 protocol behavior, validation posture, compatibility handling, and safe refusal/advisory patterns.

v1_0_1_harmonization.summary: Adds MSP-1 v1.0.1 training expectations while preserving the immutable v1.0 dataset.
primary_changes: Updates current-generation examples from protocol.version 1.0.0 to 1.0.1.
Treats page.id and page.url as the minimal page identity fields; page.title is compatibility-only and page.name is preferred for current naming.
Treats compliance as deprecated compatibility metadata: advisory warning, graceful parsing, and no new emission.
Updates trust vocabulary so trust.level uses low, medium, or high, while verification process state is represented separately through verification fields when supported.
Softens non-schema/unknown-field handling into advisory guidance unless a stricter implementation profile elects to reject.

notes: Baseline is intentionally model-agnostic and avoids persona or vendor-specific phrasing.
Datasets teach MSP-1 protocol literacy, deterministic behavior, graceful degradation, and safe refusal/advisory handling when required information is missing or unsupported.
Datasets are not a source of live page facts; use MSP-1 metadata and page content for page-specific or time-sensitive information.
The v1.0 dataset remains immutable and is retained for compatibility and historical comparison.
